================================================================================
  ATHENA — Local AI PC Agent
  How to use this project
================================================================================

Athena is a Windows-first, voice-controlled AI computer agent.

  Athena thinks → tools act → OpenClaw executes (optional)
  RAG remembers → Whisper hears → TTS speaks

Everything important runs locally. The LLM proposes structured tool calls;
Python tools and permissions actually do the work.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. REQUIREMENTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hardware (recommended)
  - Windows 10/11
  - Microphone and speakers
  - NVIDIA GPU with ~8 GB VRAM (helps Faster-Whisper)
  - 16 GB+ system RAM

Software
  - Python 3.12
  - Ollama  ->  https://ollama.com
  - Git
  - NVIDIA drivers (for GPU speech recognition)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. FIRST-TIME SETUP
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A) Open a terminal in the project folder:

      cd D:\Projects\Jarvis

B) Create / activate the virtual environment:

      py -3.12 -m venv .venv
      .venv\Scripts\activate

C) Install packages:

      python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
      pip install -r requirements.txt

D) Create your local config (never commit .env):

      copy .env.example .env

E) Pull local AI models:

      ollama pull qwen3.5:9b
      ollama pull nomic-embed-text

F) Confirm Piper voice files exist:

      voice\models\en_US-lessac-medium.onnx
      voice\models\en_US-lessac-medium.onnx.json

G) Scan installed apps (builds the application registry):

      python scripts\scan_apps.py

H) Run a health check:

      python scripts\health_check.py

I) Make sure Ollama is running:

      ollama serve

J) (Optional) Configure OpenClaw — see section 7A below.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. START ATHENA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Recommended — system tray + dashboard:

      python gui\tray_app.py
   or
      python -m ui.tray

  Tray menu:
    - Start / Stop Listening
    - Pause / Resume
    - Open Dashboard   (Owl's Vigil status widget)
    - Settings (.env)
    - Recent Activity / Permissions / Logs
    - Restart Services
    - Exit

Voice loop only (console):

      python main.py

Dashboard only (Owl's Vigil realtime HUD):

      python -m ui.dashboard
   or
      python app.py --dashboard

Packaged exe (after build):

      powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_exe.ps1
      dist\Athena\Athena.exe

Windows startup (optional):

      powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install_startup.ps1


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. HOW TO TALK TO ATHENA
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Start Listening from the tray (or run python main.py).
2. Wait until Athena is listening for the wake word.
3. Say:  "Hey Athena"
   (also: "Hi Athena", "Okay Athena", or "Athena")
4. She activates and says she is online.
5. Speak your request when recording starts.
6. Watch the Owl's Vigil dashboard for live phase:
     Idle → Listening → Thinking → Speaking
7. Keep giving commands until you stop listening or shut down.

Exit phrases:
  - "Shutdown Athena"
  - "Close Athena"
  - "Stop Athena"
  - "Go offline"

Ask for progress anytime:

  - "Status"
  - "Mission status"


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. WHAT YOU CAN ASK
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Apps (friendly names — Athena resolves the real path)
  - "Open Notepad"
  - "Open Visual Studio"
  - "Open Docker Desktop"
  - "Close Notepad"

Files
  - "Search Downloads for CSV files"
  - "Read notes.txt"
  - "Create a file called notes.txt"
  - "Move report.csv into Data"     (may ask confirmation)

Chat / memory (RAG)
  - "What is ClickHouse MergeTree?"
  - "Ingest the document report.pdf"
  - "What does my project memory say about the ETL path?"

Browser
  - "Search the web for latest ClickHouse docs"
  - "Open https://clickhouse.com/docs"
  - Uses OpenClaw when enabled + browser tool available; otherwise local browser

Development
  - "What's the git status of this project?"
  - "Run the tests"
  - "Create a project called demo_app under D:\Projects"

Data engineering
  - "Check my data stack"
  - "Check Docker / ClickHouse / Airflow"
  - "Analyze the sales CSV on my desktop"
  - "Analyze the sales.xlsx workbook"

Email (needs SMTP/IMAP in .env)
  - "Draft an email to Maryam saying I'll follow up tomorrow"
  - "Search my inbox for ClickHouse"
  - Send only after confirmation

Screen / UI
  - "Take a screenshot"
  - "Read what is on my screen"
  - "Find Save on my screen"
  - "Click the Save button"         (confirmation)
  - "Scroll down"                   (confirmation)

Missions / workflows
  - "Prepare my data engineering environment"
  - "Status"                        (checklist progress)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. SAFETY AND CONFIRMATIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Athena never lets the model invent executable paths or run arbitrary
computer control without the tool + permission layer.

Typical confirmation-required actions:
  - Delete files
  - Send email
  - Git commit
  - Shutdown / restart / sleep
  - Click / type / press keys on screen

LOW-risk tools (open app, read file, search, status checks) usually run
automatically. Edit policy in:

      config\permissions.yaml
      .env   (CONFIRM_MEDIUM_RISK, CONFIRM_HIGH_RISK, ...)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. CONFIGURATION (.env)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Copy from .env.example. Important keys:

  ATHENA_NAME=Athena
  ATHENA_VERSION=0.1.0
  OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434
  OLLAMA_MODEL=qwen3.5:9b
  EMBEDDING_MODEL=nomic-embed-text
  WAKE_WORD=hey athena

  OPENCLAW_ENABLED=true
  OPENCLAW_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:18789
  OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=your-gateway-token

  SMTP_* / IMAP_*          optional email send + inbox search
  CLICKHOUSE_* / AIRFLOW_* optional data-engineering checks

Never commit real passwords or gateway tokens. Keep secrets only in .env.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
7A. OPENCLAW (EXECUTION GATEWAY)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OpenClaw is an execution provider, not Athena's brain.

  Flow:
    LLM → Tool → Permission → OpenClaw (or local fallback) → Windows

Configure in .env (token comes from your OpenClaw gateway config):

  OPENCLAW_ENABLED=true
  OPENCLAW_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:18789
  OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN=<gateway.auth.token>

Example OpenClaw gateway auth block (in OpenClaw's own config, not Athena's):

  {
    "gateway": {
      "mode": "local",
      "auth": {
        "mode": "token",
        "token": "<same-value-as-OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN>"
      }
    }
  }

What stays LOCAL (Athena tools):
  - Application open / close
  - Files, system status, development, data engineering
  - Screen / UI automation

What can use OpenClaw when healthy:
  - search_web
  - open_url
  (mapped to OpenClaw "browser" tool)

If OpenClaw is down or a tool is not available on the gateway,
Athena falls back to the local browser / local tools.

Verify:

  1. Start the OpenClaw gateway (listening on port 18789).
  2. Set OPENCLAW_* in .env (never commit the token).
  3. Run:  python scripts\health_check.py
     Expect:  OpenClaw     OK  connected

  Unit / stub tests:

      .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest Tests\unit\test_openclaw.py -v

Notes:
  - HTTP gateway denies exec/spawn/shell by default — that is intentional.
  - If health is OK but browser actions fail with
    "Tool not available: browser", enable the browser tool in OpenClaw policy.
  - Details: docs\openclaw.md


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. USEFUL FILES AND FOLDERS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  main.py                      Voice loop entry
  app.py                       Packaged / alternate entry
  gui\tray_app.py              Tray launcher (compat)

  config\settings.py           Typed settings
  config\permissions.yaml      Risk / confirmation lists
  .env.example                 Safe config template
  core\orchestrator.py         Central coordinator
  tools\                       Deterministic tools
  tools\applications\          App discovery / launch / match
  tools\development\           Git / Python / project tools
  tools\communication\         Email + IMAP
  openclaw\                    Optional execution gateway
  monitoring\                  Health / system / status IPC
  data\cache\athena_status.json
  data\logs\activity.jsonl
  resources\athena-concept-1-owls-vigil.html   Design reference
  logs\athena.log
  docs\installation.md         Full install guide
  docs\ui.md                   Tray + dashboard notes
  docs\troubleshooting.md      Common fixes
  skills\                      Short skill notes for Athena domains


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
9. COMMON PROBLEMS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

"No speech detected"
  - Speak closer to the mic; check Windows microphone privacy settings

Wake word not working
  - Say clearly: "Hey Athena"
  - First Whisper load can take several seconds

Ollama errors
  - ollama list
  - ollama pull qwen3.5:9b
  - Confirm OLLAMA_HOST in .env

App not found
  - python scripts\scan_apps.py
  - Use friendly names ("Visual Studio"), not full .exe paths

Dashboard looks stale
  - Tray → Restart Services
  - Re-open:  python -m ui.dashboard

Email / inbox fails
  - Configure SMTP_* and IMAP_* in .env  (see docs\email.md)

OpenClaw shows FAIL / disabled
  - Confirm OpenClaw gateway is running on OPENCLAW_ENDPOINT
  - Set OPENCLAW_ENABLED=true and OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN in .env
  - Re-run: python scripts\health_check.py

OpenClaw connected but browser rejected
  - Gateway is up; enable the "browser" tool in OpenClaw policy
  - Until then Athena uses the local browser fallback

GPU STT falls back to CPU
  - Update NVIDIA drivers
  - pip install nvidia-cublas-cu12 nvidia-cudnn-cu12

More help: docs\troubleshooting.md


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
10. QUICK TESTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Unit tests:

      .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest Tests\unit -q

Health:

      python scripts\health_check.py

V1 smoke (no microphone):

      python scripts\v1_smoke.py

Version / update check (notify only):

      python scripts\check_update.py

App scan:

      python scripts\scan_apps.py

Wake / chat smoke tests (optional):

      python -m Tests.wakeword_test
      python -m Tests.chat_test

OpenClaw tests:

      .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest Tests\unit\test_openclaw.py -v


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
11. TYPICAL DAILY USE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  1. Start Ollama (if needed).
  2. Start OpenClaw gateway (if using OpenClaw).
  3. Activate venv:   .venv\Scripts\activate
  4. Confirm health:  python scripts\health_check.py
       (OpenClaw should say OK connected when enabled)
  5. Start tray:      python gui\tray_app.py
  6. Open Dashboard from the tray (Owl's Vigil).
  7. Start Listening.
  8. Say "Hey Athena", then your command
       e.g. "Open Visual Studio"
       e.g. "Check my data stack"
  9. Confirm when Athena asks for dangerous steps.
 10. Stop Listening or Exit from the tray when done.
